description: Measured from 2.2M real export emails: replies per 10,000 emails at each follow-up step, the recommended number of emails, how many days to wait before the next one (follow_up_after_days), when replies arrive, what replies say (interest, questions, meeting requests…), and the funnel per 10,000 emails. Use to set a sequence's length and timing.
name: outreach_playbook
title: How many emails, when, and what replies say
